scope: Two completed TP2 DSpark-five API/IPC experiments; no default promotion or broad warmup qualification.

build.construction: Independent local builds from one archived source context; OCI image IDs differ by rank.
build.ipc_preflight: Actual installed module import and real ZMQ reader/writer construction at default,0.002,0,1 seconds passed during both builds.

model.verification: Previously inventoried matching config/index hashes and 48 nonempty indexed shards on both hosts; full payload checksums and revision provenance were not reverified.

conditions.hardware: Two NVIDIA GB10 DGX Spark systems

rate_definitions.aggregate: Total completion tokens divided by batch wall time, including prefill.
rate_definitions.per_request_decode: Tokens after the first nonempty SSE token-ID chunk divided by time between first and last such chunks.

cpu_measurement.method: 100 times delta(user+system /proc/PID/stat ticks) / SC_CLK_TCK / host monotonic interval.
cpu_measurement.scale: 100 percent represents one fully occupied logical CPU; totals sum measured container processes.
cpu_measurement.selection: PIDs present in both snapshots; no CPU-affinity pinning or power measurement.
cpu_measurement.counter_retention: Reported per-PID percentages and exact intervals retained below. Raw cumulative tick snapshots and clock frequency were not retained; no reconstructed ticks are asserted.

api_contract.interpretation: Candidate positive calls and explicit contract-error results passed. Parent full one-token calls already returned InternalServerError; only the streaming baseline reproduced HTTP200 empty calls. The complete source/API upgrade was not varied independently from the wrapper.
api_contract.coverage: Eight named/required, full/stream, positive/one-token cases on the one-second arm; this matrix was not repeated on the two-millisecond arm.

warmup_observation.interpretation: Nine preparation-kernel warning events per rank, not nine established unique cache keys. Typed specialization correction is separate; warm-cache warnings do not measure cold compilation.

excluded_failure.failure: DeepSeek SpinCondition raised NameError for os because an extracted-class fixture had supplied the missing module.
excluded_failure.handling: Not counted as a successful serving arm. Commit 9f5b1e619d037d1ae365f158135c3de42402cf4e binds the dependency and adds an installed-module preflight.

limitations: The control received36 calibration requests before benchmarking; the two-millisecond arm did not. Cache and warmup histories are unmatched.
Prompt-processing singleton results are retained but cannot establish a prefill improvement or regression.
Three batches per concurrency and one roughly50-second workload CPU window per arm do not establish significance, latency-tail bounds, stability or power savings.
Cancellation, burst/idle latency tails, complete-queue notification reliability, long soak and broader restart coverage remain required before IPC default promotion.
Responses reasoning=max completed in both response modes on both arms; this is not general model-quality or API-conformance qualification.
No profile default, published image identity or public repository artifact was changed by these experimental results.
